CLOUD-FOREST WATERFALL RIDGE — high-elevation cloud-forest waterfall cascading over moss-blanketed boulders, hanging orchids and bromeliads on the wet cliff-walls, mist-saturated air blurring the tree-line, ferns dripping with condensation in the foreground, a valley of low cloud stretching away below the ridge, the bloom-colors vivid against the grey-green mist.

LAGOON WITH BLOOM-ISLAND — oval turquoise lagoon with a small vegetation island at its center, the island completely covered in tropical blooms and palms, calm water reflecting the island in near-perfect symmetry, the outer reef framing the scene, distant salt-haze on the horizon, the bloom-island brilliant against the surrounding blue-green water.

TIDAL POOL BLOOM EDGE — rocky tropical tide-pool at low tide, vivid bougainvillea and hibiscus shrubs massing directly behind the pool on the coastal rock, palms angling from the shoreline, the open Pacific glittering in the background through salt-haze, bloom-reflections trembling in the tidal pool's shallow water, the coast receding in both directions.

CENOTE TROPICAL SPRING — natural cenote cut into pale limestone, turquoise water lit from within, hanging vines and roots descending from the rim into the void, tropical blooms massing at the rim-edge, light shafts penetrating the steam and illuminating the water surface, the deep walls covered in ferns, orchids, and dripping moss.

WATERLILY PALM LAGOON — a wide shallow lagoon entirely covered in giant Victoria water-lilies and white lotus, palms tilted over the water along the far bank, tropical blooms blazing at the shoreline, the far rainforest receding into deep humid haze above the waterline, the lily-pads creating a green-on-blue geometry across the entire middle ground.

BEACH COVE WITH BLOOM-SHRUBS — a sheltered horseshoe cove of pale sand with yellow and red hibiscus shrubs growing thick at the high-tide line, coconut palms framing the scene, calm shallow water glowing aquamarine within the cove-walls, the headland cliffs receding into coastal salt-haze, the blooms crowding the boundary between sand and jungle.

EPIPHYTE-LADEN OLD GROWTH TREE — single massive tropical hardwood trunk filling the foreground, every branch-fork loaded with bromeliad chandeliers, hanging orchids cascading in long chains, mosses and lichens covering the bark, the dense humid jungle receding behind into deep green blur, a shaft of light catching one spectacular orchid bloom against the shadowed canopy.

ATOLL EDGE FRANGIPANI GROVE — low atoll-edge with frangipani trees in full bloom, white and yellow flowers dense overhead and fallen on the pale coral-sand, the inner lagoon visible through the grove in brilliant turquoise, salt-haze softening the far reef line, the sand scattered with fallen blooms creating a natural floral carpet at the water's edge.

PHILODENDRON CLIFF FACE — a towering vertical cliff draped entirely in giant philodendron, monstera, and climbing-vine mass, hanging orchids and bromeliads studding the rock face, the jungle floor below lost in humid shadow, a sliver of tropical coast visible in the far distance dissolving into salt-haze, the bloom-colors explosive against the deep green vertical carpet.
